caption: Discovery
description: The OASF skills and domains of an artifact, without the record around them, so that other formats can embed them as an extension. The payload is carried under the extension key org.agntcy.discovery.v1: as the params of an A2A AgentExtension whose uri is the key, or as the value of the key in an AI Catalog extensions map.
name: discovery

schema_version.caption: Schema Version
schema_version.description: The version of the OASF schema the payload conforms to.

skills.caption: Skills
skills.description: List of skills associated with the artifact.

domains.caption: Domains
domains.description: List of domains associated with the artifact.
